articles.title: Stillroom: a document inbox that does the sorting and waits for you
articles.excerpt: This is a submission for the Hacktoberfest Open-Source AI Challenge Week 3: Slow and Steady. My downloads folder does not need another clever filename. It needs someone to read the file, decide what i…
articles.body: This is a submission for the Hacktoberfest Open-Source AI Challenge Week 3: Slow and Steady . What I Built My downloads folder does not need another clever filename. It needs someone to read the file, decide what it is, and put it somewhere I can find it later. I kept putting off those little decisions, so I built Stillroom . Stillroom is a local document inbox. I can drop in a PDF, TXT, Markdown, or CSV file. An open-weight model proposes a category, useful title, document date, summary, tags, and archive path. It must also copy a quote from the file to explain the choice. I see the original text next to the proposal, can correct it, and must approve the move. If I change my mind, Undo brings the original back.
articles.author: Aditya mishra

articles.body: TL;DR Most "Mismatched value (page crawl) [price]" and "Mismatched availability" disapprovals in Google Merchant Center come from drift : your product feed and your live storefront briefly disagree, and Googlebot crawls at that moment. Drift risk is everywhere in real catalogs. In four public Shopify stores we probed on Oct 20, 2026, 15–85% of variants were on sale (compare-at price set) and 13–82% were sold out . One brand's 250 products expanded to 2,720 variants, each a separate feed item . Google says it re-crawls disapproved products over "the next few hours or days" and may take up to 12 hours to review a website check, so every drift costs you visibility for a while. Do the free manual audit below once. Then automate a daily storefront-vs-feed diff .

articles.title: Coding a Voltage Drop and Wire Size Calculator in JavaScript
articles.excerpt: When you're designing a branch circuit or sizing the conductors for a panel feed, the conversation quickly narrows to one question: how much voltage is going to disappear between the source and the lo…
articles.body: When you're designing a branch circuit or sizing the conductors for a panel feed, the conversation quickly narrows to one question: how much voltage is going to disappear between the source and the load, and what wire size will keep that drop acceptable? Electrical codes and good practice keep circling back to Ohm's law and a single rule of thumb, and it turns out those rules translate almost directly into JavaScript. In this post we'll build the math for a voltage drop calculator and a wire size calculator , work through a real example, and write a short function that picks the smallest American Wire Gauge (AWG) size that keeps voltage drop under the familiar 3 percent guideline. Ohm's law and the voltage drop idea Ohm's law is the starting point: V = I × R.

articles.title: SlothSort 🦥: The Zero-Effort, Local AI File Organizer
articles.excerpt: What I Built I built SlothSort, a background digital butler that rewards peak laziness. Like most developers, my Downloads folder is a chaotic graveyard of files named Screenshot_10222026.png, invoice…
articles.body: What I Built I built SlothSort , a background digital butler that rewards peak laziness. Like most developers, my Downloads folder is a chaotic graveyard of files named Screenshot_10222026.png, invoice_final_v2_FINAL.pdf, and asdfasdf.jpg. I am simply too lazy to rename and organize them manually. SlothSort is a lightweight Python agent that monitors your messy folders. Channeling true International Sloth Day energy, it waits exactly 24 hours before acting on any new file. Once a file hits the "sloth threshold," the script wakes up, analyzes the file using a local open-weight model to determine context, generates a clean, descriptive file name, and moves it to a neatly categorized directory (like /Invoices, /Work_Docs, or /Images).

articles.title: Bash Parameter Expansion Forms You Will Actually Use
articles.excerpt: You know the basics: ${var:-default} gives you a fallback. ${var:=default} assigns it. Fine. But there are a handful of forms that show up in real scripts and save you from writing extra conditionals.…
articles.body: You know the basics: ${var:-default} gives you a fallback. ${var:=default} assigns it. Fine. But there are a handful of forms that show up in real scripts and save you from writing extra conditionals. The Ones Worth Remembering ${var@Q} — shell-quote the value This is the one I reach for when passing arguments through SSH or building command strings that need to survive parsing. cmd = "docker run --rm alpine echo ${ msg @Q } " ssh host " $cmd " Without @Q , a message like hello world becomes two arguments. With it, you get 'hello world' — single argument, preserved. ${arr[@]@Q} — quote every array element Same idea, but for arrays.

articles.title: Android handhelds are running PS5 games now
articles.excerpt: Not big 3D PS5 games, but PS5 games nonetheless.
articles.body: TL;DR An Android PlayStation 5 emulator called CapyPS5 is currently able to run a handful of PS5 games at playable frame rates. The games were tested on the AYN Odin 3, a relatively powerful Android-based game handheld. The emulator is currently in alpha. Emulation’s nothing new on Android — with a little elbow grease, it’s fairly easy to get Xbox, PlayStation, and Switch games running on your phone or game handheld. Now, somebody’s even got PS5 games up and running on the AYN Odin 3 . Ghael, developer of the Lemon Switch emulator we covered last week, is back at it with CapyPS5 . Based on the FEX x86-64 emulator and KytyPS5 PlayStation 5 translation layer for desktop operating systems, CapyPS5 is a work in progress, but Ghael’s already got a handful of PS5 games running well on Android.

articles.title: 'Cabin leak suspected': Artemis II astronaut reveals how a warning nearly derailed NASA's epic moon mission
articles.excerpt: Victor Glover recalls how a suspected cabin leak warning came just 15 minutes before a crucial engine burn — and why receiving it just five minutes later could have changed everything.
articles.body: TENERIFE, CANARY ISLANDS — NASA's Artemis II astronauts were just minutes away from a critical engine burn that would send them toward the moon when an unexpected cabin leak warning threatened to change the course of their historic mission. "If it had happened five minutes later, we may not have been able to have that burn," Artemis II pilot Victor Glover revealed during an Oct. 18 discussion with Canadian former astronaut Chris Hadfield at the Starmus VIII festival here in Tenerife. The incident unfolded on April 2, the second day of the Artemis II mission, as the astronauts' Orion spacecraft swooped back toward Earth after traveling some 38,000 miles (61,000 kilometers) away.

articles.body: A satellite image of "Spider Crater" in Western Australia. (Image credit: NASA Earth Observatory image by Michala Garrison, using Landsat data from the U.S. Geological Survey ) From the dangerous Sydney funnel-web to the common huntsman, Australia is home to its fair share of spiders. It even has a crater shaped like one. What is it? One stretch of the vast Western Australia wilderness is imprinted with a curious crater, which likely formed after a meteor impact hundreds of millions of years ago. Geologists think the spider-like pattern in the crater's center was created when its floor rebounded following the initial impact, NASA has said . In the hundreds of millions of years since the initial impact, erosion has continued to carve this formation into its current, signature shape.

articles.title: Next Mass Effect game cancelled as EA shuts down legendary sci-fi RPG studio BioWare
articles.excerpt: The legendary RPG studio behind classics such as Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic, Mass Effect, and Dragon Age is no more.
articles.body: The writing was on the wall, but the news still hit us like a truck yesterday. BioWare, the iconic RPG studio behind the Mass Effect and Dragon Age series, is no more. Development on the next Mass Effect has stopped, but EA might not be entirely done with the IP. Variety reported, backed by EA’s own statement and BioWare’s goodbye on socials , that EA is laying off 3% of its global workforce and closing down BioWare. The shift comes shortly after the company went fully private this summer , with Saudi Arabia and private equity acquiring it alongside all its studios and properties.

articles.title: NASA giving update about Artemis moon plans on Oct. 23: Watch it live
articles.excerpt: NASA will provide an update about its Artemis III mission and its plans to land astronauts on the moon during a press conference on Friday (Oct. 23). Here's how to watch it live.
articles.body: NASA will provide an update about its Artemis moon plans on Friday (Oct. 23), and you can watch it live. The news will come during a press conference at the agency's Kennedy Space Center in Florida, which starts Friday at 2 p.m. EDT (1800 GMT). You can watch it live here at Space.com, courtesy of NASA. "The update will include details about NASA’s Artemis III mission that will send four astronauts to low Earth orbit next year to test critical systems needed for future lunar landings, and how plans to return American astronauts to the moon by 2028 are progressing," NASA officials said in an Oct. 14 media advisory . The crew of NASA's Artemis II mission captured this photo of a crescent Earth on April 6, 2026, as they began passing behind the moon.
